inputs.prompt: Original Soulmonsters hand-drawn 2D manga anime. Delicate fine gray ink, expressive oval eyes, simple nose and chin, slim youthful proportions, clean flat local colors, restrained cel shadows. No 3D, pixel art, poster painting, thick cartoon outlines, collage, titles, subtitles or logos. Maintain the identities, relative sizes and costume construction of the references. Motion must be actual character animation with changing joint poses and environmental movement, not a still-image zoom or slideshow. No spontaneous duplication or transformation. Tyler is the slim boy with black swept spiky hair, only three white outer side tufts (never an entirely white fringe), reddish eyes, ivory short-sleeved hooded jacket and burgundy lining/tails, black V-neck shirt/cropped trousers, fingerless gloves, small gold wheel pendant, burgundy sneakers. Saber is ONE white/pink living paper-kite feline: two attached upper saber fangs, four dark paws, red eyes, small gold collar bell, bamboo burgundy/ivory diamond sail on shoulders with a sakura emblem, one connected pink petal-ribbon tail. Her kite, tail, fangs and limbs stay attached. The girl Lia has warm brown skin, short dark curly bob, a single large yellow leaf-shaped hair clip, teal short poncho with cream collar, mustard shorts, brown ankle boots and a small coral crossbody satchel. She is a frightened young forest explorer, never a duplicate of Tyler. Lacertubo is ONE large low quadrupedal folded-paper lizard: angular teal and golden-orange triangular panels, cream articulated joints, white claws, bamboo spars and orange knot joints, triangular dorsal sail/spines, segmented orange/teal pennant tail. No fire dragon, organic green dinosaur or metal robot. He is about twice Saber's body mass, with broad low stance, not gigantic. <Picture 1> is the START KEYFRAME and scene layout, not a sheet. <Picture 2> and <Picture 3> are character IDENTITY references only; never show sheets, text or white reference backgrounds in the film. Climactic wide anime battle action with readable silhouettes: Saber LEFT facing RIGHT, Lacertubo RIGHT facing LEFT, Tyler far LEFT maintains kite line, Lia safely behind him, SAME bridge stream and leaning tree. Seconds0-2 Saber launches in a low powerful four-legged leap toward RIGHT, attached sail catches pink wind. Seconds2-4 two clean pink petal crescents arc forward from her saber fangs and shoulder kite and HIT Lacertubo's triangular side panels, one sharp white cel-animation impact frame and dust, NOT a full-screen dissolve. Seconds4-6 Lacertubo is pushed BACK onto the dirt before the bridge, slips, folds his legs and falls onto his side, clearly defeated but alive, no blood or dismemberment. Seconds6-8 Saber lands upright on four paws center-left, pink petals settle while Lacertubo remains motionless except breathing at far right. The wooden bridge stays intact and path is now clear. Audible rush, decisive paper-crack impact, small ground thump then quiet stream. No speech, no music, no reset.
